sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a canonical branch-selection or evidence term; the candidates represent propeller diameter, MCR speed, and ship only.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the presence-only speed check with the required conditional alternative: accept a documented known MCR bollard rotational speed, otherwise require propellerDiameter on the ship and constrain the speed to the applicable Table 6-9 value using the exact diameter bands and rpm constants.
